title: Emberfall Warden
hero_description: a masked lantern knight in amber and cobalt armor, clearly viewed from directly above
core_mechanics: fight rust stalkers with frontal lantern melee
collect sparks and gear into an inventory
complete the hermit's quest to unlock a dash and the forge
defeat a telegraphed two-phase forge warden
story_premise: A lantern-bearing warden crosses a dimming keep to relight its heart-forge, trading sparks with the hermit who survived its fall.
theme_thread: Every recovered spark restores a promise the ruined keep had forgotten.
win_condition: Complete the hermit's quest, enter the heart-forge, defeat its warden, and relight the forge.
lose_condition: Hero health reaches zero; restart from the latest room checkpoint.

levels.name: The Ember Keep
levels.description: Three connected top-down forge chambers: a blue hermit court, a violet rust vault, and a red heart-forge carved with luminous runes.
levels.outro_beat: The heart-forge answers the lantern with a living flame, and warmth returns through every wall of the keep.
levels.pressure_notes: Use durable pursuit enemies, ten reachable quest sparks, a sealed final room, and a faster enraged boss phase.

art_style: high-contrast painterly pixel art with amber light, deep cobalt shadows, and readable top-down silhouettes
audio_mood: warm low strings, distant hammer percussion, and a rising forge pulse

key_item.description: a faceted golden forge spark with a white-hot center, viewed from above
